title: Anytime Valid Confidence Bands for Distribution Functions
abstract: arXiv:2610.36149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nonparametric inference often requires characterizing an unknown function, such as a cumulative distribution function (CDF), across its entire domain rather than a specific point. We develop confidence bands for distribution functions of a data stream that are valid simultaneously over all times and all points, even when each observation may depend arbitrarily on the past. We begin by deriving such bands for the time-averaged conditional CDF and show how their widths are determined by the depth of a binary search tree. We then show that this result is an instance of a framework through which one can construct valid confidence bands uniformly over time and over an arbitrary index set for any indexed family of time-averaged distribution functions. We illustrate the framework on importance-weighted and right-censored CDFs, as well as multivariate CDFs.

translated_title: 分布函数的随时有效置信带
translated_abstract: 非参数推断通常需要刻画未知函数（例如累积分布函数 CDF）在整个定义域上的表现，而不仅限于某个特定点。我们为数据流的分布函数构建了在所有时间和所有点上同时有效的置信带，即使每个观测值可能以任意方式依赖于过去。我们首先为时间平均条件 CDF 推导出这样的置信带，并展示其宽度如何由二叉搜索树的深度决定。随后我们证明这一结果是一个更一般框架的实例，借助该框架可以为任意带索引的时间平均分布函数族，构建在时间和任意索引集上一致有效的置信带。我们在重要性加权 CDF、右删失 CDF 以及多元 CDF 上演示了该框架的应用。
tldr: 该论文为数据流的分布函数构建了在所有时间和所有点上同时有效、且允许观测值任意依赖过去的置信带，并进一步将其推广为适用于任意索引化时间平均分布函数族的统一构造框架。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs anytime-valid confidence bands for distribution functions of data streams that are simultaneously valid over all times and all points, even under arbitrary dependence on the past, and generalizes the result into a unified framework for arbitrary indexed families of time-averaged distribution functions.
